player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in a game of Indian Poker.
- 52-card deck; you see only the opponent's card.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) each round, {max_rounds} round(s) total.
- Valid moves: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X is a positive integer <= your chip count.)
- Highest hidden card wins the pot at showdown.

invalid_move.ambiguous: Pewuka ekikomo kya moja kibaju, kama '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', au '[fold]'.
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: Tewali kya kuyita; oyinza [check] mu kifo ky'ekyo.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Kozesa [bet X] okuggulawo; tewali kusasula kw'ogenda okwongeza.
invalid_move.insufficient: Si kivve ekimala okukola ekintu ng'ekyo.

message.showdown_tie: Showdown tie: bombi {card}. Pot split  buli omu afuna {split}.
